svg.aria-label: Model 2204 · board layout (derived) — redrawn board layout diagram
svg.text: Redrawn from Marshall model 2204 STD factory drawing, sheets 2204PRE.DGM (iss 4, 19-5-88) and 2204PWR.DGM (iss 2, 18-6-89) — layout derived from these schematics; no factory layout drawing located, and the circuit is built on the JM80 printed board — not a trace
T1 — Marshall 1202-324 · 240/220/120 V primary · HT + 6.3 V heaters

Heater layer: no factory board-layout drawing exists for this amplifier, so its heater wiring cannot be read off one. At the centre-tapped valves (V1, V2, V3) it shows the two heater pins on opposite supply legs — the 12.6 V series arrangement; a 6.3 V supply straps them into one leg and returns on the centre tap. The valves on the chain are this circuit's own; the order the chain reaches them in is this
Note: the 6.3 V heater twisted pair always routes on the top layer and never joins another run — its crossings are not hop-overs.
6.3 V heaters — twisted pair (leg grouping not established)
